from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-2/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy, xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            colored = [(y, x) for y, x in cells if grid[y][x] not in (0, 8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            top = min(y for y, x in colored)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in colored)
            left = min(x for y, x in colored)
            right = max(x for y, x in colored)
            th, tw = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
            tile = [row[left:right + 1] for row in grid[top:bottom + 1]]
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = tile[(y - top) % th][(x - left) % tw]
    return out
'''
